title: Quoting Note — Pricing the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans Against the Owner's Portfolio Claim History
content:
A plan of the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans is priced against the owner's claim history across the portfolio, not against one unit alone. The rule applies when a plan is quoted and when it is renewed.

## The rule

> The history counted is the approved claims on that owner's warranty plans in active, pending renewal, suspended or expired status over the three cover years before the quote day; declined and cancelled plans are not counted. An owner whose approved claim value over that history exceeds half the premium they paid is quoted at the tier above the one asked for, or quoted with the units that drove the claims excluded. The portfolio history never changes the per-claim or per-term caps of the tier written, which are always the tier's own.

The claim history window is the three cover years immediately before the quote day.

## Condition, judgement, result

- **What is counted.** The value of approved claims on the owner's warranty plans whose status is active, pending renewal, suspended or expired, adjudicated within the three cover years immediately before the quote day. A plan in declined or cancelled status contributes nothing to the history, whatever claims it carried.
- **What it is compared with.** Half the premium the owner paid over that same history.
- **The test.** The approved claim value exceeds half the premium paid.
- **When the test is met.** The owner is quoted at the tier above the one asked for, or quoted with the units that drove the claims excluded.
- **What never moves.** The per-claim and per-term ceilings of the tier actually written are the tier's own; the history does not raise or lower them.

## Hypothetical figures

| Premium paid over the three cover years | Half of it | Approved claim value over the same history | Test met |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18000 USD | 9000 USD | 9500 USD | Yes — quoted at the tier above the one asked for, or with the units that drove the claims excluded |
| 18000 USD | 9000 USD | 9000 USD | No — the claim value equals half and does not exceed it |
| 18000 USD | 9000 USD | 4200 USD | No |

In the first row, an owner asking for the Parts & Labor Protection Plan is quoted at the Compressor Coverage Plan, or at the Parts & Labor Protection Plan with the units that drove the claims left off.

## Points of judgement

- A claim on a plan the owner cancelled two years ago is outside the history even though it falls inside the three cover years, because cancelled plans are not counted.
- A claim on a plan that has since expired is inside the history, because expired plans are counted.
- The comparison is claim value against half the premium paid; a claim count on its own decides nothing under this rule.
- Where the quote is written at a higher tier because of the history, the ceilings applied to that plan are the higher tier's own ceilings.
